intent: To demonstrate the effectiveness of the smallpox eradication program, using the elimination of cases in India as evidence for its global success.

units.meaning: India’s reported smallpox cases fell to 0 in 1975, the final year in the series.

basis.note: final year and zero reported cases

accepted_routes: By 1975, reported smallpox cases in India reached zero.
The series ends at zero cases for India in 1975.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The final 1975 data point or bar must be shown at 0 and labeled as 0 cases or zero.
units.temporal_anchor: The clause about India’s elimination or the final drop.
units.reviewer_question: Must the video explicitly state that India’s reported cases were 0 in 1975?

units.meaning: The highest reported case count in the series was 190,000 in 1974.
accepted_routes: India’s highest reported smallpox total in this series was 190,000 in 1974.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The 1974 bar or point must be visibly highest and labeled or annotated as 190,000.
units.temporal_anchor: The clause before the final 1975 drop, establishing the peak.
units.reviewer_question: Must the video identify 1974 as the peak year with 190,000 cases?

units.meaning: Reported cases dropped from 190,000 in 1974 to 0 in 1975, a one-year decline of 190,000 cases, or a 100% reduction.
accepted_routes: The 1974-to-1975 drop was 190,000 cases, reaching zero.
Cases declined 100% from 190,000 in 1974 to 0 in 1975.
A one-year drop of 190,000 cases eliminated the reported total by 1975.
units.visual_evidence_rule: Both the 1974 value 190,000 and the 1975 value 0 must be visible, with the change annotated as -190,000 or 100% decrease.
units.temporal_anchor: The clause linking the 1974 peak to the 1975 zero.
units.reviewer_question: Must the video quantify the 1974-to-1975 reduction as 190,000 cases or 100%?

units.meaning: From the first year shown, India reported 55,000 cases in 1962; by 1975 it reported 0, a decline of 55,000 from the series start.
accepted_routes: Reported cases fell from 55,000 in 1962 to 0 in 1975.
The 1962 baseline of 55,000 cases reached zero by 1975.
Over the shown period, cases were reduced by 55,000 from the starting value.
units.visual_evidence_rule: If used, both the 1962 value 55,000 and the 1975 value 0 should be visible or labeled.
units.temporal_anchor: An optional baseline clause contrasting the start with the final year.
units.reviewer_question: Should the video include the 1962 starting value as context, or is the 1974 peak the intended baseline?

units.meaning: The 1975 value of 0 is the only zero in the series; all prior years had at least 25,000 cases, so it crosses below the previous minimum.

basis.note: the only zero in the series

units.computation: min(1962–1974 values) = 25,000 (1969 and 1971); 1975 = 0, so 1975 is below the prior minimum.
accepted_routes: In 1975, cases dropped to 0, below the earlier minimum of 25,000.
The only zero in the series occurs in 1975; prior years were at least 25,000.
India crossed from a prior low of 25,000 to zero in 1975.
units.visual_evidence_rule: If used, the chart should show prior minimum years at 25,000 and the 1975 point at 0, making the threshold crossing clear.
units.temporal_anchor: An optional clause emphasizing elimination as a threshold crossing.
units.reviewer_question: Should the video call out that 1975 is the only zero and prior years never fell below 25,000?

optional_valid: The video may frame India’s 1975 zero as a case study for the eradication program’s success, but the table itself only supports India.
It may show that cases were volatile before 1974, with 85,000 cases in 1963, 1967, and 1973.
It may use the table’s relative_value scale, where 1974 = 0.95 and 1975 = 0, if the chart uses normalized units.
It may state the 1974 peak was more than double the 1973 value (190,000 vs 85,000; +105,000).
unsupported_to_avoid: Global eradication or worldwide elimination claims from an India-only table.
Causal claims that the program directly caused the 1974-to-1975 drop without causal data.
A steady-decline narrative; the table fluctuates and has a large 1974 spike.
Wrong percentage denominators; if using percent decline, use the 190,000 1974 value or 55,000 1962 value as stated.
notes: The India-only table supports a case-study elimination claim, not global data. The core required message is the 1974 peak and 1975 zero, with the one-year drop as the strongest effectiveness evidence.
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
